data.description:
## Context
433c requires AC boxes checked before close; but checking a box edits the description, and material_fingerprint (llm/plan_review/pass1.py) hashes the raw description — so the required box-flip trips stale-material in validate_attestation (attest.py) and forces a fresh LLM review before EVERY close. Observed on all four closes of d3ed/433c/9d07/a584. Checkbox STATE is progress metadata (verified independently by the completion verifier); the ITEM TEXT is the material.

## Approach
Normalize checkbox state before hashing in material_fingerprint: case-insensitive `- [x]`/`- [X]` → `- [ ]` (also `*` bullets), line-anchored, so flipping a box never changes the fingerprint while ANY text change still does. Single seam: both the plan-review close gate and the completion-verifier staleness check recompute through material_fingerprint via current_material_fingerprint.

## Scope
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py (material_fingerprint: normalize description basis)
- tests: unit on fingerprint invariance + a close-gate-level regression

## Testing
RED first: fingerprint(desc with [ ]) == fingerprint(desc with [x]) fails today; any non-checkbox text edit still changes the fingerprint; validate_attestation no longer returns stale-material after a pure box flip.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Flipping any AC box (either direction, x or X, - or * bullet) leaves the material fingerprint unchanged.
- [ ] Any other description edit still changes the fingerprint (staleness preserved).
- [ ] A signed plan-review attestation stays valid across a pure box-flip edit (no stale-material at close).
- [ ] Existing attestations signed on unchecked descriptions remain valid for checked descriptions (normalization is backward-compatible by construction).
data.title: AC checkbox flips invalidate plan-review attestation (stale-material on every close)
